items.name: Clover
items.description: A four-leaf clover kept for good luck. Give it a flick.

items.name: Star
items.description: A wishing star for your screen. Give it a flick.

items.name: Heart
items.description: A little bit of warmth on your desktop.

items.name: Bell
items.description: Ring it when you make a wish, or before something that matters.

items.description: Gentle snow drifts down your screen and eases away from your cursor.

items.description: Leaves tumble and sway on their way down, drifting around your cursor.

items.description: Wanders along the bottom of your screen. Click it to give it a pat.

items.description: Trots back and forth along your screen. Click it to give it a pat.
